drhp.business: Mamata Machinery designs and manufactures machinery for the flexible packaging industry, with an installed base of over 5,400 machines operating across more than 80 countries. Backed by expertise in polymer processing, plastic rheology, converting, filling and sealing systems, it serves both brand owners and convertors through a single technology platform. Over more than 35 years it has grown from a single-product manufacturer into a complete provider of flexible packaging machinery present across the entire value chain, from co-extrusion to converting to packaging.

The operating model deliberately combines in-house capabilities across design, software development, engineering, electrical integration, testing and critical operations with a robust network of specialised manufacturing partners, an approach the Company says enhances scalability and operational agility while allowing efficient capital deployment.
